pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL 2.1 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end systems. Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce 600 series or equivalent)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end systems. Keyboard and mouse required.
